title: T23 follow-up agent-core: theme mirror matches playbooks' shadow check (0.7.28)
head: t23-shadow-mirror
body:
## What

- `src/anorak/theme_pack.py`'s `_valid_shadow` checked only string length (1-200 chars), so it accepted anything that satisfied that bound for `shadow-1`/`shadow-2` -- plain text, `url(...)`, named colours, wrong CSS units -- all of which playbooks' `src/garage/themes/validate.py` (`_SHADOW_LENGTH`/`_SHADOW_LAYER_RE`) already refused. Brought the mirror in step (contract `docs/t23/contract.md` §3): copied playbooks' `_SHADOW_LENGTH` (`(?:0|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?px)`) and `_SHADOW_LAYER_RE` (optional `inset` + 2-4 lengths + a `#RRGGBB`/`#RRGGBBAA` colour, comma-separated layers) verbatim, and `_valid_shadow` now runs the same length check *and* the layer-regex check playbooks does, so every shadow value gets the same accept/refuse verdict in both checkers. Kept the mirror's own error-message style (`ThemeError("shape", "light.colors.shadow-1")` etc.) -- only the validator body changed, not how failures are reported.
- Diffed the rest of the two checkers field by field (top-level required/optional keys, `name`, the `avatar` hint pattern, every other colour-key validator (`hex`, `hex-alpha`, `lamp`, `glow-strength`), `type.font`, `radius` shape/range/monotonic check, `motion` shape/range/cubic-bezier check, `sounds` shape/length check, and both contrast-pair tables/ratios/the `lamp`-vs-`bg` rule) -- every other accept/refuse verdict already matched exactly, so `shadow-1`/`shadow-2` was the only gap.
- Also checked whether agent-core ever runs the theme checker on its bundled `lantern` theme (see below) -- it does not, by design, so nothing there needed a code change.

## Lantern check (report only, no code change)

Agent-core never runs `validate_theme_bytes`/the contrast checker against `lantern`'s actual colour values anywhere: `src/anorak/themes.py`'s bundled `_PACKS` row carries only display metadata (id/name/source/installed/etc.), never a `theme.yaml` or its colours -- the real palette lives only in desktop-app's static `src/design/tokens.ts` (contract §3/§4, same split T17 uses for the Beacon avatar). `GET /themes` returns that metadata row unvalidated. `GET /themes/:id/tokens` explicitly refuses a bundled id with 404 ("this pack is built into the app") before ever calling `library.read_tokens`/`validate_theme_bytes` (`local_service.py`'s `_theme_tokens`). `PUT /theme`/`ProfileStore.save_theme` go through `_theme_known`, which returns `True` for `lantern` via `known_theme()` alone -- no §1/§2 validation call -- exactly the existing Beacon-avatar precedent. `validate_theme_bytes` is only ever invoked from `theme_library.py`, for signed-library and drawer packs, never for the bundled id. So playbooks' finding that today's Lantern light `lamp`/`bg` is ~1.69:1 (failing the 3:1 rule) has **no effect in agent-core**: lantern is never refused, hidden, or fallen-back-from anywhere in this repo -- it stays selectable and served exactly as before, because its colours are never run through this checker here at all. (Whether that finding should change what desktop-app ships as Lantern's actual palette is outside this ticket and this repo.)

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

| mutant | killing test |
| --- | --- |
| Revert `_valid_shadow` to the old length-only check (`isinstance(value, str) and 1 <= len(value) <= 200`, no layer-regex call) | `test_theme_pack.py::test_malformed_box_shadow_syntax_is_refused` -- all 9 malformed-value cases fail (garbage text, `url(...)`, named colour, no lengths, no colour, bad hex lengths, too many lengths) |
| Loosen `_SHADOW_LENGTH` to accept any unit (`(?:0|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?[a-zA-Z%]*)` instead of requiring `px`) | `test_theme_pack.py::test_malformed_box_shadow_syntax_is_refused[0 1em 2em #1f1d1a14]` -- the bad-unit case is wrongly accepted |

Each mutant was applied by editing `src/anorak/theme_pack.py`, `pytest -q tests/test_theme_pack.py` run to confirm the expected failure, then the file restored to the real fix (no `git stash`; verified by `git diff` matching the intended patch and the full suite passing again: `2671 passed, 5 skipped, 1 deselected`). 2/2 killed.

```
uv run pytest -q → 2671 passed, 5 skipped, 1 deselected
uv run ruff check . → All checks passed!
uv run ruff format --check . → 13 files would be reformatted (pre-existing drift in files this PR does not touch: tests/test_plain_words.py, tests/test_scoreboard.py, and others; confirmed `git diff` for this PR's own files is formatting-clean)
uv run mypy --strict src → Success: no issues found in 56 source files
```

Version `0.7.27` → `0.7.28` in `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock` (agent-core package entry), `src/anorak/__init__.py`, `chat_service.py` (2 `skill_version` literals), `local_service.py`'s `ServiceRuntime.version`, `local_service_adapters.py`'s `Skill.version`, and the matching test expectations in `tests/test_local_service.py`/`tests/test_service_cli.py`. `CHANGELOG.md` updated.
